summary: An individual intervenor filing as L.M. Marlowe moves FERC to open settlement procedures or appoint a settlement judge across the six show cause dockets, starting with shared technical questions on large-load observability and cost causation.
ask: Establish settlement procedures and convene a settlement conference under Rule 601, or alternatively appoint a settlement judge under Rule 603.

points.point: Marlowe asks for a settlement conference, or a settlement judge as an alternative, in the show cause dockets.
points.quote: establish settlement procedures and convene a settlement conference of the participants pursuant to Rule 601

points.point: She would start with shared technical questions on observability, cost causation, curtailment priority and boundary verification.
points.quote: large-load observability, cost-allocation and cost- causation, curtailment priority, and boundary-verification methodology

points.point: She says the rules allow settlement procedures at any time and that they can run alongside the directed responses.
points.quote: Settlement procedures may run in parallel with the responses the Commission has directed and need not await their conclusion

throughLine.text: Motion in the EL26-67 to EL26-72 dockets proposing settlement talks in parallel with the 60-day show cause responses the June orders require.
